subject: Snapshot from our discovery + decision on next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hsu <claire@avalytics.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: discovery + suggested next steps

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the 30-minute call today — really appreciated the context on Avalytics' search-product roadmap and the Q3 performance goals. Quick recap and my proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What I heard
- You need sub-150ms 95th percentile inference for query completion across multi-region users.
- Primary workload: short query/clarification prompts with embeddings for reranking.
- Compliance: SOC 2 and customer data retention policy requirements.

Our suggested approach
1) Pilot: Redwood hosted inference with a dedicated pool for your production traffic window (60k qps daily burst).
2) Optimizations: prefix caching + quantized variant to hit latency + cost targets.
3) Success criteria: 95th p95 < 150ms and token cost <$0.0008 for typical query mix.

Next steps
- I attached a short integration outline (MVP-integration-outline.pdf) showing endpoints and a minimal plan.
- If you’re happy with the approach, propose a 4-week pilot kickoff in mid-June and a quick joint tech deep-dive for engineers.

Can you confirm: are you able to start a pilot in mid-June, or should we look to July? Also, any legal/procurement constraints we should surface now?

Thanks — I’ll hold the times for a technical walkthrough next week if that helps.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: MVP-integration-outline.pdf (summary, 2 pages); 20260603-Jonas-Avalytics-discovery-notes.pdf (call notes)
From: Claire Hsu <claire@avalytics.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 14:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery + suggested next steps

Hi Jonas — thanks for the clear recap and for the slide deck. Helpful. Quick answers: 

- Mid-June is tight for us (engineering bandwidth), but early July looks reasonable.
- Procurement: we need a standard SOW and our legal team will want a data processing addendum (DPA). SOC 2 report will be required before production.

Could you send a rough estimate for pilot pricing and an SOW template so I can loop in procurement? Also please share the SOC 2 attestation link.

Regards,
Claire
Head of Platform Engineering | Avalytics
claire@avalytics.io
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hsu <claire@avalytics.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery + suggested next steps

Hi Claire — checking in on timing for the pilot and procurement items. I sent a preliminary SOW template and pilot pricing in a separate doc last week (linked in HubSpot). Quick summary here:

- Pilot cost: $12,000 flat for the 4-week dedicated pilot (covers reserved pool + engineer support).
- Deliverables: performance validation, integration guide, and a short runbook.
- SOC 2: link to attestation included in the SOW (SOC2 Type II) and we can provide redacted report under NDA.

If July works for you, I can lock in a kickoff week now. If there are internal blockers, let me know the best person to work with in procurement and I’ll loop them in.

Thanks — if I don’t hear back I’ll follow up again next week.

Jonas
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hsu <claire@avalytics.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question — should I close the file?

Hi Claire — we haven’t heard back since the SOW/estimate. I know timelines shift and priorities change, so wanted to check in once more before I close the opportunity on our end. Two options: 

1) You’re still interested but timing slipped — reply with a preferred week in July/August and I’ll hold availability and re-open the pilot plan.
2) This isn’t a priority right now — tell me and I’ll close the file; we can restart when it’s a better time.

No hard feelings either way — I just want to keep our pipeline tidy and avoid bugging you. If helpful, I’m happy to propose a short, no-commitment technical POC that requires less procurement work.

If I don’t hear back by Friday 7/16 I’ll assume you want to close and will archive the opportunity — you can always ping me to re-open.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
